card.fires_on: Responds to the middle piece of multiple sclerosis drug names such as ocrelizumab, fingolimod and interferon, and to the word after 'Multiple' in 'Multiple Sclerosis'. Also fires on 'Time' in 'Treatment Time' dosing table headings.
